scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Hey~! Hi human~ This is Mr. Dolangmal. kakaka~
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
嘿~！你好呀人类~ 我是多朗马尔先生。咔咔咔~

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
We are sent to here to take you to the heaven of cats, ^A2314BMalangdo^000000.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
我们被派到这里，是为了带你去猫的天堂，^A2314BMalangdo^000000。

scripts.text: [Dolangmal]
scripts.translation: [多朗马尔]

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
How is that? The crowded city of Prontera is good, but why don't you go our heaven of the cats, ^A2314BMalangdo^000000?
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
怎么样？普隆德拉虽然是个热闹的城市，但为什么不去猫的天堂，^A2314BMalangdo^000000呢？

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Why don't you go to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000? That place is better than Geffen, where there are only crowds of simple honest wizards.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
为什么不去^A2314BMalangdo^000000呢？那里比吉芬好多了，吉芬只有一群朴实无华的巫师。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
The fresh air of Payon is not bad, but why don't you go better place like the heaven of the cats, ^A2314BMalangdo^000000?
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
斐扬的新鲜空气虽然不错，但为什么不去更好的地方，比如猫的天堂，^A2314BMalangdo^000000呢？

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
{0}The beautiful and quiet place is better than Aldebaran, where it's so noisy with the tick-tock sound of the clock.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
{0}那个美丽宁静的地方，比阿尔德巴兰好多了，那里总是传来古钟魔滴答滴答的吵闹声。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
{0}The beautiful and quiet place is better than Morocc, with its heat and sandstorms.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
{0}那个美丽宁静的地方，比莫洛可好多了，那里又热又多沙尘暴。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
{0}The beautiful place is better than Juno, which is full of books and headaches.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
{0}那个美丽的地方，比朱诺好多了，那里全是书，让人头疼。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
{0}The complex place is better than Rachel, where it's too horribly quiet.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
{0}那个复杂的地方，比拉赫好多了，那里安静得可怕。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
{0}The safe place is better than Lighthalzen, which is too dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
{0}那个安全的地方，比里希塔乐镇好多了，那里太危险了。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
{0}The smell of this sea place is better than Mora, which is full of a grassy smell.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
{0}这个海边的味道，比穆拉好多了，那里全是草腥味。

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: ^A2314BMalangdo^000000~ Go~ Go~
scripts.translation: ^A2314BMalangdo^000000~ 走~ 走~

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
What!? You don't want to go ^A2314BMalangdo^000000? Chet!
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
什么！？你不想去^A2314BMalangdo^000000？切！

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
You're such an annoying guy. If you don't go, why did you talk to me... but...
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
你真是个讨厌的家伙。既然不想去，干嘛还跟我说话... 但是...

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
^9E1837Admiral Tomas^000000 said to kidnap humans... No... Bring them politely?
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
^9E1837托马船长^000000说要把人类绑架过来... 不对... 是礼貌地请他们过来？

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Anyway, I got you. Whenever you want to go, just tell me.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
总之，我已经把你拿下了。想走的时候，随时告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Ok! I like your attitude. Full of passion.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
好！我喜欢你的态度。充满热情。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Now, before you go ^A2314BMalangdo^000000, let me give you some warnings.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
现在，在你去^A2314BMalangdo^000000之前，让我给你一些警告。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
First!! It is natural that when you arrive on ^A2314BMalangdo^000000, you should notify ^9E1837Admiral Tomas^000000 that you are here.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
首先！！当你到达^A2314BMalangdo^000000时，你应该通知^9E1837托马船长^000000你来了。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
If you don't do that, you might be attacked by scary and wild cats when you walk through dark streets.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
如果不这样做，你在穿过黑暗的街道时，可能会被可怕且野性的猫袭击。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Secondly!! This ^A2314BMalangdo^000000 is absolutely our island of cats, even though we open to humans.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
其次！！虽然我们对人类开放，但^A2314BMalangdo^000000绝对是我们的猫岛。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
We have a personality... no... no... respect us like one catality because we are cats.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
我们要保持个性...不...不...要像对待猫一样尊重我们，因为我们是猫。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
And the next one is...
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
下一条是...

scripts.text: Dolangmal proceeds and gives hundreds of warnings.
scripts.translation: 多朗马尔继续说，给出了数百条警告。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Ok! Those are all the warnings!! They're easy and simple... right? Can you remember them?
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
好了！这些就是所有的警告！！很简单吧...对吧？你能记住吗？

scripts.text: Remember his warnings
scripts.translation: 记住他的警告

scripts.text: Can't remember
scripts.translation: 记不住

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Ok! Do not bite two mice with one mouth. ^9E1837Admiral Tomas^000000 is located at the ^A2314Bcenter of the ship in Malangdo^000000.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
好的！不要贪多嚼不烂。^9E1837托马船长^000000位于^A2314BMalangdo的船中心^000000。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Don't forget to give him notice of your arrival.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
别忘了通知他你到了。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Alright. Let's go to the heaven of the cats, ^A2314BMalangdo^000000~
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
好了。让我们去猫的天堂，^A2314BMalangdo^000000~

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
What!? Can't you keep these easy rules? Chet!
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
什么！？这些简单的规则你都记不住吗？切！

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
You're such an annoying guy. If you can't keep these, why didn't you tell me during our conversation? I told you everything... but..
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
你真是个讨厌的家伙。如果你记不住这些，为什么不在我们谈话时告诉我？我都告诉你了...但是..

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
^9E1837Admiral Tomas^000000 said to kidnap humans... No... Bring them politely?
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
^9E1837托马船长^000000说要把人类绑架过来... 不对... 是礼貌地请他们过来？

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Anyway, I got you. Just tell me whenever you want to go.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
总之，我已经把你拿下了。想走的时候，随时告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Uh? You must be the one from last time...? Alright. Did you visit ^A2314BMalangdo^000000?
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
呃？你一定是上次那个人...？好的。你去过^A2314BMalangdo^000000吗？

scripts.text: Take me to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000 again
scripts.translation: 再带我去一次^A2314BMalangdo^000000

scripts.text: I have visited
scripts.translation: 我去过了

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
I really want to send you there, but I can't because of the policy. It is difficult to send people who have visited ^A2314BMalangdo^000000 already.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
我真的很想送你过去，但由于政策原因，我无法这样做。对于已经去过^A2314BMalangdo^000000的人，很难再次发送。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
And that was roughly it... It's supposed to be rule 53...
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
大概就是这样...这应该是规则53...

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Actually, let me tell you rule 53. I am an indulgent cat.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
实际上，让我告诉你规则53。我是一只宽容的猫。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
If you want to go back to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000, take the ship at Izlude or Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
如果您想回到^A2314BMalangdo^000000，请乘坐依斯鲁得岛或艾尔贝塔的船。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
If you enjoy that pleasant sea trip, you will arrive at the heaven of cats, ^A2314BMalangdo^000000.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
如果您享受这段愉快的海上旅程，您就会抵达猫的天堂，^A2314BMalangdo^000000。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
So easy! Isn't it? Well, good bye~
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
很简单吧？那么，再见~

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
How was it? You liked it? I knew it. Kakaka~
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
感觉如何？您喜欢吗？我就知道。哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Ah! I just want to make sure...
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
啊！我只是想确认一下...

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Again, if you want to go back to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000, do you know where to take a ship at Izlude or Alberta?
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
再说一次，如果您想回到^A2314BMalangdo^000000，您知道在依斯鲁得岛或艾尔贝塔哪里可以乘船吗？

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Hm~ You might know because you're a smart person. Well, see you again~
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
嗯~ 您可能是个聪明人，所以应该知道吧。那么，下次见~

scripts.text: This cat is sleeping in the warm {0} sun.
scripts.translation: 这只猫正在温暖的{0}阳光下睡觉。

scripts.text: Let him sleep
scripts.translation: 让它睡吧

scripts.text: Talk to him
scripts.translation: 和他谈谈

scripts.text:
[Odgnalam]
Meow? Huh?
scripts.translation:
[奥德格纳拉姆]
喵？嗯？

scripts.text:
[Odgnalam]
You are a hero of cat's fleet. Your activity is the legend between us.
scripts.translation:
[奥德格纳拉姆]
您是猫舰队的英雄。您的事迹在我们之间是传说。

scripts.text:
[Odgnalam]
As you are a hero of the cat fleet let me send you to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000 for free.
scripts.translation:
[奥德格纳拉姆]
既然您是猫舰队的英雄，让我免费送您去^A2314BMalangdo^000000吧。

scripts.text: Send me to Malangdo!
scripts.translation: 送我去Malangdo！

scripts.text: Do not go.
scripts.translation: 不去。

scripts.text:
[Odgnalam]
Have a comfortable trip... Alright let's go~
scripts.translation:
[奥德格纳拉姆]
祝您旅途愉快... 好了，出发~

scripts.text:
[Odgnalam]
{0}
scripts.translation:
[奥德格纳拉姆]
{0}

scripts.text: Send me to Malangdo!
scripts.translation: 送我去Malangdo！

scripts.text: Do not go.
scripts.translation: 不去。

scripts.text:
[Odgnalam]
Money? Where is the money? You can't go anywhere without the money. Shame on you.
scripts.translation:
[奥德格纳拉姆]
钱？钱在哪里？没有钱您哪里也去不了。真丢人。

scripts.text:
[Odgnalam]
Let me send you right away. Let's go~
scripts.translation:
[奥德格纳拉姆]
让我马上送您过去。出发~

scripts.text:
[Kong]
Did you have fun in Malangdo?
The fleet has a service to Izlude and Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[孔]
您在Malangdo玩得开心吗？
我们的船队提供前往依斯鲁得岛和艾尔贝塔的服务。

scripts.text:
[Kong]
The fee of ship is only 1000 zeny, where do you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[孔]
船费只需1000 Zeny，您想去哪里？

scripts.text:
[Kong]
You have a connection with our fleet. Apply special price 999 zeny. Where do you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[孔]
您与我们的船队有联系。享受特价999 Zeny。您想去哪里？

scripts.text:
[Kong]
Wow~ You contributed to our fleet a lot. Alright!! Special discount price 500 zeny. Where do you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[孔]
哇~ 您为我们的船队贡献良多。好啊！！
给您特价500 Zeny。您想去哪里？

scripts.text:
[Kong]
Ah... You are the legendary hero of our cat's fleet.
scripts.translation:
[孔]
啊... 您是我们猫船队的传奇英雄。

scripts.text:
[Kong]
We can't charge the hero of our fleet. What is your destination?
scripts.translation:
[孔]
我们不能向船队的英雄收费。您的目的地是哪里？

scripts.translation: - 前往依斯鲁得岛 --- {0}

scripts.text: - Alberta destination --- {0}

[Kong]
{0}

You see a lazy cat standing on a chair.
You guess that this is the Innkeeper.
scripts.translation:
你看到一只懒洋洋的猫站在椅子上。
你猜测这就是旅店老板。

scripts.text: Umm... Can I rest here?
scripts.translation: 嗯... 我可以休息一下吗？

scripts.text: Psst... Can I save here?
scripts.translation: 嘘... 我可以保存吗？

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Eh?
Uh, sure you can use this hammock if you give me ^FF00005 Malangdo Cans^000000.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
咦？
呃，如果你给我^FF00005个马拉恩多罐头^000000，当然可以用这个吊床。

scripts.text: Here you go.
scripts.translation: 给您。

scripts.text: Never mind.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Now relax.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
现在放松一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
This ain't no charity.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
这可不是慈善。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Let me know if you want to relax.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
如果你想放松，告诉我一声。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Location saved. We should keep company, haha~
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
位置已保存。我们要多亲近亲近，哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Sometimes you just have to relax.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
有时候就是得放松一下。

scripts.text: - Wow, this is the laziest cat ever. -
scripts.translation: - 哇，这是有史以来最懒的猫。-

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
Boy, that lazy cat makes me want to just nap all day long.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师]
男孩，那只懒猫让我只想整天睡觉。

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
He makes life look so simple.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师]
它让生活看起来如此简单。

scripts.text:
[Wanderer]
The cats living in here are so energetic.
Is it weird that they make me want to dance all day?
La di dah di dah~!
scripts.translation:
[浪姬舞者]
这里的猫都精力充沛。
它们让我想整天跳舞，这很奇怪吗？
啦啦啦~！

scripts.text:
[Cat Trainer]
Ooo~ their soft puffy tails and soft fur~
I can't stand it, this is heaven~~!!
scripts.translation:
[驯猫师]
噢~它们毛茸茸的尾巴和柔软的皮毛~
受不了了，这里简直是天堂~~！！

scripts.text:
[Cat Trainer]
My hidden card, ^FF0000Silvervine Fruit^000000, can make all cats in Malangdo my slaves~ haha!
scripts.translation:
[驯猫师]
我的王牌出手，^FF0000猕猴桃果实^000000，能让玛朗多所有的猫都成为我的奴隶~哈哈！

scripts.text: ^FF0000Silvervine Fruit^000000?

[Cat Trainer]
It is such a rare item!
I can barely get it.
But these cudly cats can't resist it~
scripts.translation:
[驯猫师]
那是非常稀有的物品！
我很难弄到。
但这些可爱的猫对它毫无抵抗力~

scripts.text: Where can I get ^FF0000Silvervine Fruit^000000?
scripts.translation: 哪里可以买到^FF0000猕猴桃果实^000000？

scripts.text:
[Cat Trainer]
Why would I tell you when I can barely get it?
I wouldn't even tell you for all the zeny in the world~!
scripts.translation:
[驯猫师]
我本来就很难弄到，为什么要告诉你？
就算给我全世界的Zeny我也不会说~！

scripts.text:
[Cat Trainer]
All the Malangdo cats are mine~!
Muahahahaha~
With enough ^FF0000Silvervine Fruit^000000 I can be a queen in Malangdo~ ohhhh!!!
scripts.translation:
[驯猫师]
玛朗多所有的猫都是我的~！
嘿嘿嘿嘿~
只要有足够的^FF0000猕猴桃果实^000000，我就能成为玛朗多的女王~噢噢噢！！！

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

受不了了，这里简直是天堂~~！！

slaves~ muahahahaha~!
scripts.translation:

这是我的小秘密，叫做
^FF0000猕猴桃果实^000000。我可以用
它让玛朗多的猫成为我的
奴隶~嘿嘿嘿嘿~！

[Cat Trainer]
Hmm, I guess it's no wonder you don't know.
These Malangdo cats can't resist it.
But it's too rare of an item to get so you shouldn't bother trying to find it.
scripts.translation:
[驯猫师]
嗯，看来你不知道也不奇怪。
这些玛朗多的猫对它毫无抵抗力。
但这物品太稀有了，你还是别费劲去找了。

[Cat Trainer]
Actually, it's simple. You just...

[驯猫师]
其实很简单。你只要...

[Cat Trainer]
Hey, you almost made me tell my secret.
scripts.translation:
[驯猫师]
嘿，你差点让我把秘密说漏嘴了。

scripts.text:
[Cat Trainer]
One day these cats will be mine.
I can be a king in Malangdo~ ohhh~!
scripts.translation:
[驯猫师]
总有一天这些猫都会是我的。
我就能成为玛朗多的国王~噢噢~！
